lines.text: You left through the back. With the water.
lines.cap:
YOU LEFT THROUGH THE BACK.
WITH THE WATER.

lines.text: On day four, you meet another survivor.
And it costs you more than the dead ever did.
lines.cap:
AND IT COSTS YOU MORE
THAN THE DEAD EVER DID.

lines.text: An empty A road, one in the morning. Fifty miles an hour.
lines.cap:
AN EMPTY A-ROAD, 1 AM.
FIFTY MILES AN HOUR.

lines.text: Ninety miles of fuel. No weapon. And nobody knows you're alive.
Rule one. Never drive to where you sleep. Circle first.
So you take the long way. Twice.
lines.cap:
SO YOU TAKE THE LONG WAY.
TWICE.

lines.text: Headlights. Four hundred metres back. For sixty miles.
Rule two. Never let a stranger see your fuel.
You slow down. They slow down. You speed up. So do they.
lines.cap:
YOU SLOW. THEY SLOW.
YOU SPEED UP. SO DO THEY.

lines.text: Radio. Recovery in seven days. Do not convoy with unverified vehicles.
Rule three. Do not stop on open road.
One seventeen. You kill your lights, and take a junction without indicating.
lines.cap:
1:17 AM. LIGHTS OFF.
A JUNCTION, NO INDICATOR.

lines.text: Behind you, they stop. And they flash their headlights.
Three long. Three short. Three long.
That isn't a threat. That's S O S.
You keep driving.
In the mirror, their lights don't fade. They go out.
lines.cap:
IN THE MIRROR, THEIR LIGHTS
DON'T FADE. THEY GO OUT.

lines.text: And they don't come back on.
lines.cap: AND THEY DON'T COME BACK ON.

lines.text: Did you just leave someone to die?
